{{Quote|Nice try. Thing is, Skywalker, you’ve already been seen in public, so we really don’t need you anymore. And Stelikag will pay the bounty he put on you whether you’re alive or dead.|Kofter to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="COO" />}}
'''Kofter''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gangster/Legends|thug]] working for [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]]  [[Nuso Esva]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]]. He held the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] at gunpoint with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] but ultimately [[Death/Legends|died]] when Skywalker defended himself with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="COO" />
